title: 第25章 火鳞蟒凝元灵丹碧幽香第26章 追击反杀活捉
content_zh:
玉岩山脉，顾景元在山脉穿梭不止，速度很快。
身后，一条两丈左右的赤鳞巨蟒不断追击，一路上树木倒塌，动静不小。
“该死，怎么这么难缠？只希望赤玉能快点得手了。”
顾景元拿出压箱底的中品疾风符箓，不断提速。
在山脉厮杀已经三个月了，几种法术都提升不小，赤玉也逼近炼气五层的关口。
原本想以谨慎为主，可数天前顾景元深入山脉时意外发现了一处地谷，那边是火山熔浆的一个宣泄口，有熔浆支脉延伸，其中居住了一条一阶上品，媲美炼气八层初期的火鳞蟒。
而这火鳞蟒守护着一株赤炎莲，除此之外，他还看到了几株蟒血草，火元草，火灵芝，都是不错的灵药。
思来想去，顾景元便打算引开火鳞蟒，然后让赤玉去采摘，为此还购买了几张中品疾风符，以及一张上品瞬风符。
突然追击的火鳞蟒一顿，似乎察觉了老巢那边不对劲，便想返回。
顾景元怎么可能允许，金剑术激发，同时毒蝎剑刺去。
砰~
铛！
攻击没能击破火鳞蟒的鳞甲，但也成功让其怒火滔天。
下一刻，火鳞蟒口吐赤焰火球，砰的一声，火球炸开，化为漫天火雨笼罩而下。
顾景元祭出罡铁盾顶着炽热火焰逃遁包围圈，但紧接着而来的便是赤色巨尾，破风阵阵。
罡铁盾立刻激发，挡在身前。
嘭！
顾景元倒飞出去，口吐鲜血。
这一击的力道太大了。
不过来不及疗伤，火鳞蟒再次杀来，同时口中火焰凝聚。

“不好！”
顾景元毫不犹豫，手中的上品冰剑符爆发。
咻咻咻~
砰砰砰！
寒冰利剑袭杀，打断了火鳞蟒的火焰蓄势，也阻挡了它的攻击，同时寒冰将其身躯封印。
趁着这个机会，顾景元手掐法诀，上品法术金元剑气凝聚，锐利锋芒自生。
“斩！”
咔咔，砰！
攻击落下，火鳞蟒也正好脱困，迎头遇上金元剑气。
火鳞蟒直接被留下一道不浅的伤口，加上身上刚刚冰剑符留下的伤，算得上遍体鳞伤，只是都不重。
“差不多了。”
顾景元见状，掉头就走。
拖延这么久，也差不多了，赤玉那边通过契约通知他，已经得手，正在离开，让他去接应。
火鳞蟒原本还想继续追击的，可心系巢穴，加上顾景元刚刚爆发的符箓，还是心有余悸，思索后便没有追击了。
顾景元一边逃遁，一边双手分别捏着上品金刃符和上品瞬风符。
只要情况不对劲，他会毫不犹豫地激发。
弯弯绕绕，很快顾景元在一棵大树上找到了赤玉。
赤玉叼着个袋子，里面正是那些火属性灵药，以及几块熔岩矿石。
“好，太好了，我们先走。”
将袋子收入储物袋，赤玉收入灵兽袋，顾景元立刻返回坊市。
content_en:
In the Yuyan Mountains, Gu Jingyuan kept traveling through the mountains at a very fast speed.
Behind him, a giant red-scaled python about two feet long kept pursuing him. Trees fell down along the way and there was a lot of movement.
"Damn it, why are you so difficult to deal with? I just hope Akadama can succeed soon."
Gu Jingyuan took out the middle-grade Gale Wind Talisman from the bottom of the box and kept increasing his speed.
It has been three months since he fought in the mountains. Several spells have improved a lot, and Akadama is approaching the fifth level of Qi refining.
Originally he wanted to be cautious, but a few days ago when Gu Jingyuan went deep into the mountains, he accidentally discovered a valley. There was a vent for the volcanic lava, with branches of the lava extending. There lived in it a first-order high-grade fire-scale python that was comparable to the early stage of the eighth level of Qi Refining.
The fire scale python was guarding a red flame lotus. In addition, he also saw several python blood grass, fire essence grass, and fire lingzhi, all of which were good elixirs.
After much thought, Gu Jingyuan planned to lure the fire-scaled python and let the red jade be harvested. For this purpose, he also purchased several mid-grade wind talismans and a high-grade instant wind talisman.
The fire-scaled python that suddenly pursued it paused, seeming to have noticed something was wrong in its lair, and wanted to return.
How could Gu Jingyuan allow it? He stimulated his golden sword skills and stabbed with the poisonous scorpion sword at the same time.
Bang~
Bang!
The attack failed to break through the scales of the fire-scaled python, but it succeeded in making it furious.
The next moment, the fire-scaled python spit out a red flame fireball. With a bang, the fireball exploded and turned into a rain of fire that filled the sky.
Gu Jingyuan used his iron shield to escape the encirclement against the blazing flames, but what followed was a huge red tail, breaking the wind.
The Gang Iron Shield was immediately activated and blocked in front of him.
Bang!
Gu Jingyuan flew backwards, vomiting blood.
The force of this blow was too great.
But before he could heal his wounds, the fire-scaled python came to kill him again, while the flames condensed in his mouth.
"Not good!"
Gu Jingyuan did not hesitate, and the high-grade ice sword talisman in his hand exploded.
咻咻咻~
Bang bang bang!
The ice sword attacked, interrupting the fire scale python's flame charge and blocking its attack. At the same time, the ice sealed its body.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Gu Jingyuan used his hand to create a spell, and the high-grade spell's golden sword energy condensed, creating a sharp edge.
"Cut!"
Click, bang!
The attack fell, and the Fire Scale Python escaped from the trap and encountered the Jin Yuan Sword Qi head on.
The fire-scaled python was left with a deep wound directly. In addition to the injury caused by the ice sword talisman, it was covered with bruises, but they were not serious.
"Almost."
When Gu Jingyuan saw this, he turned around and left.
After delaying for so long, it was almost over. Akadama informed him through a contract that he had succeeded and was leaving, asking him to pick him up.
The Fire Scale Python originally wanted to continue the pursuit, but because he was concerned about the lair and the talisman that Gu Jingyuan had just exploded, he was still frightened. After thinking about it, he stopped pursuing.
Gu Jingyuan ran away while holding the top-grade Golden Blade Talisman and the top-grade Instant Wind Talisman in his hands.
He won't hesitate to fire up whenever something goes wrong.
After twists and turns, Gu Jingyuan soon found Chi Yu on a big tree.
Akadama held a bag in his mouth, which contained those fire-attribute elixirs and a few pieces of lava ore.
"Okay, great, let's go first."
Putting the bag into the storage bag and the red jade into the spirit beast bag, Gu Jingyuan immediately returned to Fangshi.
